concerns.action: Define canonical schema FIRST: extend types/problem.ts ProblemTemplate with equivalenceClass?:string + calculatorFlag?:('no_calculator'|'calculator_allowed'|'calc_neutral_arithmetic_light') (camelCase = repo convention). Add validate-graph checks. Acceptance reads the SAME fields the runtime+validator read.

Items carry NO derivation metadata, so the solver does NOT re-derive answers from prose. certify() verifies WELL-FORMEDNESS (answer parses under its kind), ROUND-TRIP (checkAnswer(item, item.answer.value)===correct), and choice-integrity. Everything not mechanically confirmable is FLAGGED for human-QA, never silently passed or fabricated. Drop the '100% machine-derivable' claim. A future authored derivationSpec enables true CAS (logged).

Cross-bucket same-prompt items (different phase/sport) are legitimate coverage — NOT collapsed. Only TRUE within-bucket exact dups (same node+phase+sport+prompt+answer) collapse. Produce a reviewable dedup REPORT (node/phase/sport/answer/selection-impact) BEFORE any removal; prefer keeping over deleting when in doubt.

equivalenceClass = node + answer-kind + numbers-masked skeleton + difficulty (a STRUCTURAL family signature, documented as structural-not-calibrated; calibration refines §9.5 later). Tests assert known false-positive collisions (same skeleton, different concept/answer) get DIFFERENT classes via the discriminators.

FLAG, don't fabricate. misconceptionMap gaps (283) are flagged for human authoring, never auto-invented. calculatorFlag derived by explicit rules (computation-fluency nodes/no-calc; reasoning items calc_neutral_arithmetic_light; uncertain -> flagged).

Collapse preserves: canonical item id retained, the others removed only when provably redundant within-bucket; the dedup report is the audit record; snapshot enables restore-by-diff. No assessment references exist yet (banks are practice items), so no alias map needed now; documented.

certify() runs inside validate-graph (the existing CI/test gate) — an uncertified item (malformed answer, missing required field, choice-integrity fail) fails graph validation. Future content import calls the same gate.
